aggregation.unit: one system-result file / one source shard

benchmark_configuration.cache_policy: best-effort buffered I/O; integrity hashing and prior runs can warm pages; the harness neither drops host caches nor guarantees page residency
benchmark_configuration.io_policy: Brevis reads the immutable source directly and writes regular on-disk archive/restored files; hashing and full verification occur after each timed process
benchmark_configuration.scheduling_policy: serial execution; all archive pipelines precede all diagnostic replays; within each stage, warmups rotate and deterministic randomized measured orders are paired with their reverse
benchmark_configuration.timing_scope: external wall/RSS: immediately before process spawn through direct-child reap; internal bench/calibration fields retain their CLI-defined narrower scopes

calibration.cost_scope: input-local prior construction; reported once per shard and never included in compression or decompression timing

search_diagnostic_replay.scope: separate deterministic bench replay run after archive pipelines; these values are search/encoding diagnostics and are not compression-time components
